cameraDeniedHelp: Camera error hint under the denied-permission title; tells the user to allow camera access in browser or phone settings.
cameraUnavailableHelp: Camera error hint under the unavailable title; asks the user to close other apps using the camera.
createMusicTitle: Create page, content step: music section summary that expands the optional song picker. Short label.
createSteps: Create page workspace-nav aria-label for the postcard-making step navigation; screen-reader only.
createContent: Create page workspace tab label for the content step, meaning photos and words. Short, fits step nav.
createComposition: Create page workspace tab label for the layout-choice step. Short, fits step nav.
createCompositionTitle: Create page heading on the composition step; asks which layout feels right.
createPostcardTitle: Create page heading on the final postcard step, before photographing the front.
createContentHint: Create page hint near the content-step next button; explains adding words and 3 to 5 photos.
createChooseComposition: Create page primary button on the content step that opens layout selection.
createEditContent: Create page quiet button in the composition step returning to editing photos and words.
createContinuePostcard: Create page button label passed to the layout composer to confirm the chosen layout.
createBackComposition: Create page button on the postcard step returning to layout selection.
signInToMake: Locked create page call-to-action button when signed out; leads to account sign-in.
unlockToMake: Locked create page call-to-action button when signed in; asks to confirm with a passkey.
signInToOpen: Scan page aside button when signed out; goes to sign in before opening a postcard.
unlockToOpen: Scan page aside button when signed in but locked; asks for passkey confirmation.
signInToHistory: History page signed-out empty-state button leading to sign-in.
returnMake: Account page button after sign-in returning to the in-progress postcard creation.
returnOpen: Account page button after sign-in returning to the postcard scan page.
returnHistory: Account page button after sign-in returning to sent-postcards history.
navHome: Header logo link accessible label for the home page; includes the app name.
navScan: Main navigation item for opening a postcard. On phones it sits in the bottom tab bar under an icon: one short word.
navMake: Main navigation item for making a postcard. On phones it sits in the bottom tab bar under an icon: one short word.
navHistory: Main navigation item for sent postcards. On phones it sits in the bottom tab bar under an icon: one short word.
navMain: Header navigation landmark aria-label; screen-reader only.
navAccount: Header account link aria-label; screen-reader only because the link shows @username.
skipContent: Keyboard skip link at page top that jumps focus to the main content.
homeTitle: Home page large heading; the app's welcome slogan.
homeHow: Home page collapsible summary 'how it works' that expands the explanation.
homeExplanation: Home page text inside 'how it works'; explains private photo postcards.
homePrivate: Site footer tagline about privacy, shown at the bottom of every page.
homeAccountHint: Home page 'how it works' hint shown only when signed out; invites signing in.
accountReadyTitle: Account page heading when signed in and the passkey is unlocked.
accountLockedTitle: Account page heading when signed in but still locked.
accountHandleTitle: Account page heading during sign-up while choosing a username.
accountKeysTitle: Account page side-panel heading about keys, followed by the privacy explanation.
accountVisitHint: Account page body when signed in and unlocked; explains staying signed in in this tab.
accountNext: Account page heading above the next-action links after unlocking.

stepHandle: Step-trail label 'username' in the account flow. Short.
stepKeys: Step-trail label 'passkey'; legacy key not currently rendered by any component.
stepRecipient: Create page step-trail label 'who it's for' before choosing a recipient. Short.
stepCompose: Create page step-trail label 'photos and words'. Short.
stepPostcard: Create page step label for the final postcard step; also a workspace tab.
recipientTitle: Create page heading asking who the postcard is for.
recipientBody: Create page lead under the recipient heading; find by username or send to self.
recipientConfirmTitle: Create page heading asking the user to confirm the found recipient.
recipientOnly: Create page lead while confirming a recipient; privacy note that only this account can open it.
recipientSelfHint: Small hint inside the self-recipient choice; says send to my own account.
recipientDivider: Create page divider text 'or' between username lookup and the self-choice.
createDetailsTitle: Create page heading for the content step, meaning what goes inside.
createNoteHint: Create page hint under the note textarea; suggests a few words with the photos.
createFrontTitle: Create page heading for the camera section on the postcard step.
createFrontHint: Create page instructions under the picture-side heading; explains photographing the postcard front.
createSendHint: Create page hint above the send button when sending prerequisites are not met.
createDraftHint: Create page lead on the content step warning that the draft lives only on this page.
scanGuide: Scan page placeholder inside the camera frame; tells the user where the picture side goes.
scanGuideHint: Scan page lead under the heading; advises keeping the whole postcard in frame.
scanAccountHint: Scan page aside hint shown when signed out or locked; says sign-in is needed.
historyEmptyTitle: History page empty-state heading 'nothing sent yet'.
settingsAccountHint: Settings account section hint saying the username stays with the account.
languageHint: Settings language section paragraph describing the language for this browser.
accessLoading: Send-access section status shown while sending limits are loading.
accessUnavailable: Send-access section alert when the sending limits could not be checked.
accessRetry: Send-access button after a failed check; retries loading the limits.
accessRefresh: Send-access button that refreshes the displayed sending limits.
accessRecord: Send-access paragraph for beta mode; unlimited sending during the beta.
accessLifetime: Send-access paragraph for lifetime access; unlimited sending to self and others.
accessLifetimeScope: Send-access note under the lifetime text; printing and postage are not included.
accessSelf: Send-access table label for postcards sent to yourself.
accessOther: Send-access table label for postcards sent to others.
accessRemaining: Send-access suffix after a count, as in '1 / 2 left'.
accessSeparate: Send-access note that self and other counts are separate and do not reset.
accessAuthority: Send-access note that the final check happens when sending.
sendLimitReached: Create send status when the user's sending limit is reached.
sendLimitHelp: Create help under the send-limit status; draft is preserved and counts are separate.
sendAccessUnavailable: Create send status when the limit could not be checked, so the postcard was not sent.
sendAccessUnavailableHelp: Create help under the send-access-unavailable status; temporary, try again later.
scanPreparing: Scan page status while the recognition engine is looking at the photo.
openChecking: Scan page status while the postcard is being opened.
openDenied: Scan page error notice when the postcard can no longer be opened.
openUnconfirmed: Scan page error notice when opening could not be confirmed; check connection and retry.
openSignIn: Scan page error notice asking the user to sign in again to open the postcard.
registrationPaused: Account page notice when new account registration is paused.
accountExistingOnly: Account page signed-out paragraph; signing in works, new accounts are paused.
accountWorking: Busy status used on the account page and during recipient lookup.
accountCancel: Account page button that cancels an in-progress account action.
identityContinuityMissing: Auth error notice: the account cannot be restored because needed data was not saved.

atomicUnsupportedTitle: Atomic account heading when this passkey cannot work in this browser.
atomicUnreadableTitle: Atomic account heading when the created passkey could not be read.
atomicUnreadableBody: Atomic account body after an unreadable passkey; sign-up cannot finish here.
atomicUnsupportedBody: Atomic account body when the passkey cannot protect postcards in this browser.
atomicUnsupportedHint: Hint under the unsupported-passkey error; retrying on the same device likely will not help.
atomicResumeSavedHint: Hint telling how to resume later with the same Google account and username.
atomicVerifyAgain: Atomic account button to retry the same passkey after a failure.
atomicSignInBody: Atomic account body at the start; continue with Google to find or create an account.
atomicHandleBody: Atomic account body when choosing a username; people will find the user by it.
atomicHandleHint: Atomic account hint under the username input; length and allowed characters.
atomicContinue: Atomic account submit button to continue after choosing a username.
atomicCreateTitle: Atomic account heading prompting the user to save a passkey.
atomicCreateBody: Atomic account body explaining where the passkey lives and that no password is needed.
atomicCreate: Atomic account button that creates the passkey.
atomicCreating: Atomic account status while the device or password-manager window is open.
atomicCreatedTitle: Atomic account heading after the passkey was created.
atomicVerifyBody: Atomic account body asking the user to choose the newly created passkey.
atomicVerify: Atomic account button to check the passkey.
atomicVerifyHint: Atomic account hint that the account is ready once this check passes.
atomicPendingBody: Atomic account body when the passkey is created but not linked; keep the page open.
atomicLink: Atomic account button in the pending state to check and link the passkey.
atomicFinishHandle: Atomic account submit button when finishing a conflicting username.
atomicStepCreate: Account step-trail label 'passkey' during sign-up. Short.
atomicStepVerify: Account step-trail label 'check' during passkey verification. Short.
atomicLater: Account options button to leave and finish sign-up later.
atomicOptions: Account page collapsible summary 'more options' during sign-up.
atomicPrivacy: Account side-panel paragraph saying photos and words are encrypted for one recipient.
atomicHandleSummary: Account label 'your username' above the chosen handle during setup.
atomicSaving: Account status while the account is being saved.
atomicUnknown: Account warning when the server did not reply; check before retrying and do not start over.
atomicCheck: Account button to check the account status; also the heading in the unknown phase.
atomicRetry: Account button to retry the same step after an unknown result.
atomicReauthenticate: Account status prompting Google sign-in again to resume the account.
atomicRestore: Account status that the account is saved; confirm with the same passkey.
atomicAssertion: Account status asking to check the same passkey once more.
atomicTerminal: Account status when sign-up expired or was cancelled.
atomicRestart: Account button to start sign-up again after it expired.
atomicReady: Account status confirming that sign-in is complete.
atomicLeave: Account button to leave sign-up after a capability stop.
atomicLeaveHint: Account hint explaining that leaving sign-up is safe for already saved accounts.
atomicUnavailable: Account error notice when sign-up is not available right now.
atomicFailure: Account generic error notice when a sign-up action failed.
historyDates: History row collapsible summary 'dates and details'.
historyBody: History page lead explaining the sent list; opening still needs the physical postcard.
historyAuth: History page signed-out empty-state text asking the user to sign in.
historyEmpty: History page empty-state paragraph 'nothing here yet'.
historyUnavailable: History page alert when the history could not load.
historyRetry: Retry button after a history or recent-people load failure.
historyRefresh: History page toolbar or empty-state button that reloads the list.
historyMore: History page button to load earlier entries.
historyRecipient: History row fallback label when the recipient is unknown.
historySelf: History row recipient label when the postcard was sent to yourself.
historyPublished: History row date label 'sent' for the publish date.
historyRevoked: History row date label 'cancelled' for the revocation date.
historyDeadline: History row date label 'can be cancelled until'.
historyCode: History row label before the postcard code.
historyNoCode: History row text when no postcard code exists.
historyRetiredCode: History row text when the postcard code no longer works.
historyCopy: History row button that copies the postcard code.
historyCopied: History row status after the code was copied successfully.
historyCopyFailed: History row status when copying failed; suggests selecting the code by hand.
historyCancel: History row button that starts cancelling the send.
historyConfirm: History row confirmation legend 'cancel this postcard?'.
historyPolicy: History row paragraph explaining when cancellation is no longer possible.
historyKeep: History confirmation button that keeps the postcard.
historyConfirmCancel: History confirmation button that confirms cancellation.
historyCancelling: History row status while cancellation is in progress.
historyCancelled: History row status after cancellation succeeded.
historyConflict: History row notice when it is too late to cancel.
historyUnknown: History row notice when cancellation could not be confirmed.
historyDraft: History row status label 'draft, not sent'.
historyReady: History row status label 'waiting to be opened'.
historyPending: History row status label 'waiting for the recipient'.
historyUnsupported: History row status label for an unknown status; asks the user to update the app.
recentTitle: Create recipient step collapsible button 'recent' that opens recent people.
recentBody: Text under the recent people panel; tap a name to send again.
recentEmpty: Recent people panel empty text 'no one yet'.
recentUnavailable: Recent people panel alert when loading failed.
recentChanged: Create recipient notice when the username now belongs to someone else.
shellReady: Settings app status when offline mode is ready; explains what still needs internet.
shellPreparing: Settings app status while offline mode is being prepared.
shellTestOnly: Settings app status for a test build that works online only.
deploymentUnavailable: Global warning banner when account actions are paused; close other app tabs and reload.
shellTestOffline: Status banner when offline in a test build that needs internet.
shellUnsupported: Settings app status when the browser cannot work offline.
shellUnavailable: Settings app status when offline mode setup failed.
shellOffline: Status banner when offline; the app can be viewed but signing in and sending need internet.
shellUpdate: Status banner when an update is waiting; close all app tabs to update, unsent drafts lost.
shellInstall: Settings button that installs the app.
shellInstallHelp: Settings paragraph explaining how to add the app to the home screen.
shellInstalled: Settings paragraph confirming that the app is installed.
homeOpenTitle: Home page receive card heading 'got a postcard?'.
homeOpenBody: Home page receive card text about photographing the picture side.
homeMakeTitle: Home page create card heading; also the locked create page heading.
homeMakeBody: Home page create card text; also the locked create page lead.
scan: General action label 'open a postcard'; home card and account next links.
make: General action label 'make a postcard'; history and account links.
back: Generic back button or link; account page, sign-up footer and photo viewer close.
language: Settings section heading and language menu accessible label.
account: Header account link text and Settings account section heading.
authBody: Account page body asking to use the postcard's account; also the locked atomic body.
phaseAuthenticated: Session status asking to confirm with the passkey to continue.
signOut: Account page button that signs out.
lock: Account page button that locks the session.
scanTitle: Scan page large heading 'show us the front'.
scanWaiting: Scan page paragraph under the camera placeholder; the photo stays on the device.
errorRegion: Internal sentinel that suppresses the global alert; not normally visible copy.
continueGoogle: Sign-in button to continue with Google.
openWithPasskey: Account page button to unlock with an existing passkey.
linkRequired: Auth error: this email already has an account; sign in to it instead.

chooseHandle: Legacy sign-up instruction to pick a username; not currently rendered by any component.
handleLabel: Form label 'username' in recipient, account and settings screens.
cancelRegistration: Button that cancels sign-up; used on the account page and in options.
handleTaken: Sign-up error when the username is already taken.
handleInvalid: Sign-up error listing allowed username length and characters.
registrationFailed: Sign-up error when creating the account failed.
prfUnavailable: Passkey error: this passkey cannot encrypt postcards here; retrying will not help.

passkeyUnavailable: Passkey error when the browser does not support passkeys.
savePasskey: Account page button that saves a passkey.
identityAbsent: Sign-up error when the tab lost the sign-up data.
recoveryCodeHint: Account paragraph introducing the one-time recovery code.
recoveryPending: Account notice that the passkey is saved but setup is not finished.
wrongPasskey: Auth error when the passkey belongs to a different account.
googleUnavailable: Auth error when Google sign-in is not available here.
googleCancelled: Auth error when the Google window was closed.

closeCamera: Scan and create button that closes the camera.

cameraDenied: Camera failure title when camera access was not allowed.
cameraUnavailable: Camera failure title when the camera is not available.
closeSheet: Postcard viewer button that closes the sheet.
photoViewer: Photo hotspot button label and photo viewer dialog/counter label.
previousPhoto: Photo viewer button to show the previous photo.
nextPhoto: Photo viewer button to show the next photo.
exportComposition: Postcard viewer button that saves the composition as an image.
sheetPreparing: Postcard viewer status while the image is being prepared.
sheetUnavailable: Postcard viewer status when the image could not be prepared.
sheetSaveFailed: Postcard viewer status when saving the image failed.

scanCancelled: Scan notice when recognition was stopped or cancelled.

scanRetake: Scan error asking for another photo because this one did not work.
syncRejected: Scan error when incoming postcards could not be checked.
createLocked: Locked create page paragraph explaining sign-in is needed to send.
forMyself: Self-recipient choice label and self marker in the recipient line.
recipientNotFound: Create recipient notice when no user has this username.
recipientConfirm: Create button confirming the found recipient.

selfRejected: Create error when this account cannot be picked.
frontHeld: Create status after the front photo is captured.
frontWorking: Create status while the front photo is being processed.

noteTooLong: Create hint shown when the note reaches its length limit.
removePhoto: Create photo thumbnail button that removes the photo.
photoEarlier: Create photo thumbnail button that moves the photo earlier.
photoLater: Create photo thumbnail button that moves the photo later.
photoCount: Create hint saying 3 to 5 photos are needed.

photoLoading: Create status while photos are being prepared.
createComposeFailed: Create alert when photos could not be prepared for composition.
